notes.title: New Content Update Available
notes.notes:
New free content update for Break Stuff with Coins has just been released, including a new level, five new coins, a new mini-game, and additional updates to some of the old levels.

For full details of all the changes, see the patch notes below.

Levels
- Added a new Level
- The Kids' Rooms level has been tweaked. Things built from multiple objects, for instance a Jigsaw puzzle, will now yield points when 'broken'.
- A few interesting changes have been made to the Shop Level.
- The plumbing has been fixed in the kitchen.
- A new Food Item has been added to the Kitchen.
- A few Items have been added to the Living Room Level.

Coins
- Added Five new Coins.
- Amped up the Gravitational Coin - Things caught in the gravitational rifts now becomes brittle, and break more easily.
- The Racer Coin has been tuned. It now packs a bit more 'vrooom'.

Achievements
- 16 New Achievements have been added, including 1 secret achievement.

Butler
- Nigel has a few more opinions about how well or how bad you are doing.
- Nigel now shuts up when leaving the Coin case, while he's talking about a coin.

Fixes
- Fixed save data issue for a few players.
- Fixed issue in living room that caused two different music tracks to be played at the same time.
- Fixed a rare performance issue in the Garage level.
- Fixed an issue where a few items would randomly break on their own in the Kids' Rooms level.
- Fixed issue where some items would jitter during slow motion.
- Fixed issue where the cable with the bike in the Garage Level, could go 'crazy' and bug out the entire level. If too much pressure is on the cable it should break instead. 
- Fixed some Audio related issues in the Kitchen level.
- Fixed an issue where some UI elements wouldn't show the correct text after changing language from the Options menu.

Additional Info
I've received a few reports about the Garage Level crashing when using the Earth Coin on the Car. I have not been able to replicate that issue, and as such not been able to fix it. If you have that issue, I'd appreciate any information on how to replicate it. I have a hunch that it may be happening when the framerate drops a bit low, so if that is the case, please let me know.

notes.title: Break Stuff with Coins v1.0.3 - Music Update
notes.notes:
Break Stuff with Coins v. 1.0.3 has just been released on Steam. This update includes Music, Unique saves on a Steam user basis and Steam Cloud support.
All the new Stuff and fixes are listed below.

New Stuff

Music has been added to all levels. Remember to adjust the volume to your liking!
Game data are now stored based on the Steam User. This means multiple Steam accounts can finally play the game on the same machine, without using the same save files!
Steam Cloud Saves are now supported.

Fixed Stuff

Fixed some items not being 'attacked' by a certain coin.
Fixed a rare issue, where spending a toss, could cause a crash.
Fixed issue where some breakable objects flipped 90 degrees the instant they got destroyed.
 Fixed rare issue, where some items, would move a very tiny amount each frame. This would only be apparent when doing nothing for a long time (eg. being afk for a few hours), which could result in some stuff moving off shelves.
Fixed some rare crashes related to a specific coin.

More to come in the future- I'm still hard at work on a major content update.

Have fun Tossing and Breaking out there!

notes.title: Break Stuff with Coins v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Over the last couple of weeks, several changes and bug fixes have been applied incrementally to the game.
Additionally work has begun on new content for the game, which is not included in the patch notes below.

Changes

Added more breakable items to the garage level.
Added delay after the last coin has stopped before the level ends. This was done to avoid the player missing out on points made right after the coin stopped. You can still use the action button to force the level to end.
Removed two 'defective' Mouse Traps from the Kids' Rooms level.


Fixes

Fixed various UI and localization issues
Fixed issue with Fade screen on huge resolutions
Fixed issue when opening the menu while loading or quitting the game.
Fixed issue where the wrong resolution would sometimes be set when clicking the apply button in Options.
Fixed issue where a certain object in the Garage Level could end up in a position where it was extremely hard to reach it. Also made more obvious visual indicators, to show where the object is.
Fixed Numeric Movement in the Office
Tweaks in regards to unlocking a certain coin in the Garage levels
Fixed bug, where you could get infinite tosses when using the Earth Coin on your last toss.
Fixed bug, where a certain coin, to be found in the Alien Ship level, sometimes fell through the floor, making it impossible to pick it up.
Fixed issue with the Force Field in the Alien Ship level, making it impossible to earn a certain achievement.
Fixed a broken collider in the Training Basement
Fixed an issue in the Training Basement where Wadsworth would comment on the player not hitting anything, even if they did.
Fixed a couple of broken achievements
